changes.summary: Google Meet mode can speak and listen: say() plays Aura speech into the call through a microphone the tester controls, hear() waits for others to talk and transcribes it with timings, admit() lets people in when the tester hosts, userDataDir keeps a signed-in Chrome profile between runs, and a refused guest join now throws a clear error.

Joining Meet no longer crashes when the page reloads mid-join, answers the "Do you want people to see you?" camera prompt, and a kept profile that reopens its last tabs launches instead of failing to resize them.
Expose an optional closed promise on transports; the Twilio WebSocket transport reports socket closure.
Observe transport closure during waits, decisions and speech, preserving the actual ending reason and duration.
